name: Kougo-yaku
statement: This Bible is in the Public Domain.

evidence.quote: Those texts are based on the Colloquial Japanese Bible Published in 1954/1955 ( whose copyright is expired at 1 Jan 2006 ).

verification.note: The Japan Bible Society's colloquial translation of 1954/1955. A work in an organisation's name was protected for 50 years after publication under the Japanese law then in force, so it ended on 1 January 2006, before the 2018 extension. The publisher's later printings differ slightly and may be protected; this is the 1954/1955 text.
